description: This is a PHP unit test class for the ProjectAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It contains multiple test methods for creating, fetching, updating, and deleting projects via API calls, utilizing mock services and fixture data.

classes.name: ProjectAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ProjectAPI endpoints in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes tests for create, get all, get one, update, and delete project API functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by clearing the EntityManager before each test.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a project via the API with data provided by the data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create project API test, fetching scenarios from a YAML data source.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all projects via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for fetching all projects.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests fetching a single project by ID via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test scenarios for fetching one project.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a project via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test scenarios for updating projects.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a project via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for project deletion.
